title: Drift-Away On 30a | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Drift-Away on 30a — a townhouse in Watersound, Florida. 7 guests · 2 bedrooms · 2 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to Drift-Away on 30A! Your perfect coastal escape in the heart of Prominence. This beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bath retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and laid-back beach living. The home features a master suite for a relaxing retreat, along with a separate bunk room, making it a great setup for couples, families, or a fun getaway with friends.Just steps from the seasonally heated resort-style pool, you can spend your days soaking up the Florida sunshine or relaxing poolside. Located directly across the street from The Big Chill, you’ll have some of 30A’s best dining, live music, shopping, and entertainment right at your fingertips.When you’re ready to explore, hop on the bikes or cruise around in the golf cart for an easy ride to the beach and nearby 30A favorites. Spend your days along the sugar-white sand, explore the charming coastal communities along scenic 30A, or head back home to unwind after a day in the sun.Whether you’re planning beach days, poolside afternoons, evenings at The Big Chill, or simply relaxing together, Drift-Away on 30A is the perfect home base for your next beach getaway. Come settle in, slow down, and drift away into vacation mode!TWO STORY UNIT1st Floor— Garage2nd Floor— Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, 2 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths, Balcony, and Laundry RoomACCOMMODATIONSDrift-Away 30a comfortably accommodates up to 7 people:Bedroom 1: 1 King with EnsuiteBedroom 2: Double/Double Bunk Bed With TrundleSleeper SofaWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterFEATURES4 Adult Bikes4 Seater Golf CartResort-Style Community PoolLarge Private BalconyFully Stocked KitchenDrip/Keurig Coffee MakerFull Washer/DryerSmart TVsBeach GearThe Big ChillWALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April)Beautiful Cabana Area with GrillsRestaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee ShopsShoppingAmphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More30-A Bicycle TrailPlease Note:*Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not includedPARKINGOne parking space available.The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community.Included is a 4 seater golf cart and 4 adult bicycles for your convenience.To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and driver's license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost.PROMINENCE AMENITIESProminence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools, and a beautiful cabana area for grilling.*Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April*NEARBY BEACH ACCESSDeer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points.Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites!Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach.Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach.THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB")The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays!HOTSPOTS NEARBYThe location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east.Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including balcony*No parties or events.*Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid driver's license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues, no wifi, or slow wifi.*Home must remain pet free!IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
